verdict.rationale: Entra ID is a SaaS identity service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. The only evidence is a probe pointing to an official Microsoft MCP server at the Microsoft Learn training/support path. That appears to be a documentation-focused Learn MCP server, not an Entra-specific server for managing tenants, users or policies. missing for 10: an Entra-specific official MCP server exposing identity operations (e.g. over Microsoft Graph), setup and auth docs for connecting agents, a tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
